stories.title: Safety first as councillor tells Flintshire residents with on-street parking not to buy electric cars
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet Member for the Environment has advised residents not to purchase electric cars if they can’t charge them. Cllr Chris Dolphin also called for UK and Welsh Government to come up with a national policy for residents without off-street parking to safely run charge cables to their electric vehicles. stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board sees increase in “never events”
stories.summary: The number of “never events” has increased within Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board over the past 12 months. stories.title: Around 827,000 Child Trust Funds still unclaimed, HMRC says
stories.summary: Young people in Flintshire born between September 2002 and January 2011 may have an unclaimed Child Trust Fund, with around 827,000 matured accounts still waiting across the UK.
